title: Proposal groups: mention + agent proposals on one pair coexist and are decided together
rationale: SPEC wants one tend card per pair. findDuplicate only dedups within a source class (roots:mention vs agent), proposalGroup() collects pending edge proposals on the unordered pair, and decide.ts accepts members matching the chosen rel (or rel:null) and rejects the rest with 'human chose <rel>'; reject rejects the whole group. Lock order: proposals.jsonl outer, graph.jsonl inner (edges.ts).
